#en:
Watchtower

To start the questline, jump to a level 15 or higher system.

Alternatively, you can go into the game's main menu, then go to Settings > Gameplay Options and find the Watchtower section. Here you can change the Start Level to LEVEL 55, or choose PYRAAS SYSTEM to have the quest start only when entering the Pyraas System.


Fleet Command

Fairly early in the questline, you will be given access to a terminal for assigning Crew to your additional ships, as well as setting basic behavior for those ships. Those ships will then follow you everywhere in space and assist in combat.

Initially, you'll only be allowed one of your extra ships to be crewed, but bringing additional Computer Cores to Gren will allow you to expand that number up to as many as 9.

If you don't want your Fleet to make general space encounters too easy, you can change the Gameplay Setting "Fleet Availability" to Limited, which will ensure they only show up during Watchtower space battles, which are designed with a Fleet in mind.


Orbital Strikes (Skydrop)

In addition to Fleet Command, Gren will also activate and unlock Skydrops. These are ship attachments that allow you to call in orbital strikes on planets.

[Unlocking] Bring Computer Cores to Gren to unlock additional ship parts. Return to him regularly to see if he has more available to unlock.

[Installing] Gren will offer to modify your ships, and is the one person who can install Skydrop modules. These can be found under the Equipment section.

You'll want to install these on your other ships, not your Home ship. Each installation of a Skydrop will add a certain number of charges for that type, allowing that many to be called down in a single planetary excursion.

[Using] To call down strikes, you'll need to use a Skydrop Flare. These can be Favorited for quickly accessing the selection menu.

After selecting the type you want from the menu, it will close and you will be equipped with a flare programmed for that type. After throwing it, the Skydrop will be deployed in a few seconds near where the flare impacted.

You can purchase additional Skydrop Flares from Gren, as well as craft them from an Industrial Workbench.

[Recharging] As you use Skydrops, the charge count will go down in the menu. If you run out of charges, you won't be able to call down more until you recharge.

To recharge them, speak to Gren or BABS, each will have an option to recharge them. Recharging is a single price to charge all of your Skydrops in one go, you don't have to individually select which to recharge or pay more if you have more Skydrops installed.



Hunting Watchtower Arrays

After you've reached the point in the story where you are introduced to the Major Arrays, you may find that the Major Array space battles are extremely tough.

To make them more manageable, you can reduce the number of ships guarding them by destroying linked Minor Arrays. To determine which systems are linked, you have two options.

[UI] While not piloting your ship, you'll find a new button on the furthest zoomed out version of the Galaxy Map labeled "Watchtower (Major)", pressing this button will switch to "Watchtower (Linked)". The lines that appear show you the various systems the linked Minor Arrays exist in.

[Mission Log] The terminal Harper pointed you to that explained the Major Arrays has an attachment that will enable a list of the linked system locations as a quest under the Misc tab.

[Hunting] To locate the specific location of an array to destroy it, you can bring Harper Intel, or pay her credits to reveal the locations of planet-side listening posts, which each have a terminal revealing the space coordinates of the array in that system.

Additional Watchtower Intel can be found in containers, ship wreckage, and the remains of destroyed arrays. 


Cyberamps

The facial attachment Gren wears can be yours. These use the same slot as the Neuro Amps, but instead of providing minor social bonuses, these generally provide ship related bonuses. You can equip these to yourself, and your Crew to enhance the ship they are assigned to.

After the early quests, Harper will eventually mention recruiting Dr. Laine to Stardock. Dr. Laine will provide an initial one, as well as offer the service to unlock additional options and upgrades to Cyberamps from Computer Cores.

Once a Cyberamp is unlocked, Dr. Laine will sell additional copies of it you can purchase.



Stardock

Stardock can be found in the Piazzi system orbiting Piazzi IV-C after you've had the initial Watchtower encounter.

As you engage in the various systems the characters of Stardock offer, you'll find that over time Stardock evolves aesthetically and functionally, adding additional services, patrons, and amenities.

[Player Home] One of the unlocks is a player home, which will give you a small apartment you can customize.

[Contraband Storage] Near BABS, Gren, and Dr. Laine you'll find containers labeled "Secure Contraband Storage". These containers are safe to leave your contraband, as well as items used for the various systems at Stardock - such as Computer Cores. 

The various characters will be able to detect those items in any of the Contraband Storage containers, so that you don't have to retrieve those items to engage in their services.
zh:
瞭望塔

要开启任务线，请跃迁至等级15或更高的星系。

或者，你可以进入游戏主菜单，前往"设置 > 玩法选项"，找到瞭望塔部分。在这里你可以把起始等级改为等级55，或选择"派拉斯星系"，让任务仅在你进入派拉斯星系时开启。


舰队指挥

在任务线较早阶段，你会获得一台终端的权限，用于把船员指派到你的其他舰船上，并设置这些舰船的基本行为。此后，这些舰船会跟着你前往太空中的任何地方并协助战斗。

起初，你只被允许为其中一艘额外舰船配备船员，但把更多计算机核心交给格伦后，可将上限提升至9艘。

如果你不想让舰队把一般的太空遭遇变得太简单，可以把玩法设置中的"舰队出勤"改为"有限"，这样它们只会在瞭望塔太空战中出场——那些战斗本就是按有舰队参战来设计的。


轨道打击（空投）

除舰队指挥外，格伦还会激活并解锁空投。这些是飞船附件，让你能对行星呼叫轨道打击。

[解锁] 把计算机核心交给格伦以解锁更多飞船部件。定期去找他，看看是否有更多部件可解锁。

[安装] 格伦会主动提出改造你的飞船，也是唯一能安装空投模块的人。这些模块可在"装备"栏下找到。

你应当把它们安装到你的其他舰船上，而不是母舰上。每安装一次某种空投，都会为该类型增加一定次数的使用次数，让你在一次行星探索中呼叫相应次数。

[使用] 要呼叫打击，你需要使用空投曳光弹。可将其加入收藏，以便快速打开选择菜单。

在菜单中选定想要的类型后，菜单会关闭，你将被配上为该系统编程的曳光弹。投出之后，空投会在几秒内部署在曳光弹落点附近。

你可以从格伦处购买更多空投曳光弹，也可以在工业工作台制作。

[补充次数] 使用空投时，菜单中的次数会减少。如果没有次数了，你需要补充后才能再次呼叫。

要补充次数，请与格伦或BABS交谈，他们都会有补充选项。补充是一口价，一次性为你所有空投充满次数，你无需逐个选择要补充哪个，也不会因为安装了更多空投而多付费。



猎杀瞭望塔阵列

当故事进展到向你介绍主阵列的阶段后，你可能会发现主阵列的太空战极其艰难。

要使其更容易应付，你可以摧毁相连的小型阵列，从而减少守卫它们的舰船数量。要确定哪些星系相互关联，你有两种办法。

[界面] 在不驾驶飞船时，你会在银河地图最远缩放层级上看到一个标着"瞭望塔（主）"的新按钮，按下该按钮会切换为"瞭望塔（相连）"。出现的连线会显示相连小型阵列所在的各种星系。

[任务日志] 哈珀指给你的那台解释主阵列的终端附有一份附件，可在"杂项"标签下将相连星系位置列表启用为一个任务。

[猎杀] 要定位具体阵列并摧毁它，你可以把瞭望塔情报交给哈珀，或花信用点让她揭示行星地表各监听哨的位置，每个监听哨都有一台终端，会揭示该星系内阵列的太空坐标。

更多瞭望塔情报可在容器、飞船残骸以及被摧毁阵列的残骸中找到。


赛博增幅

格伦佩戴的面部附件也可以属于你。它们使用与神经增幅器相同的槽位，但一般提供飞船相关加成，而非社交方面的微幅加成。你可以给自己装备，也可以给船员装备，以强化他们被指派的舰船。

在早期任务之后，哈珀最终会提到把莱恩博士招募到星坞。莱恩博士会提供第一款赛博增幅，并提供用计算机核心解锁更多赛博增幅选项和升级的服务。

一旦某个赛博增幅被解锁，莱恩博士会出售可额外购买的副本。



星坞

在首次遭遇瞭望塔之后，你可以在皮亚兹星系找到星坞，它环绕着皮亚兹IV-c运行。

当你逐步体验星坞角色们提供的各种系统时，你会发现星坞会随时间在美观和功能上不断进化，增加更多服务、顾客和设施。

[玩家住所] 其中一项解锁是玩家住所，会给你一间可以自定义的小公寓。

[违禁品储藏] 在BABS、格伦和莱恩博士附近，你会发现标有"违禁品安全储藏柜"的容器。这些容器可以安全存放你的违禁品，以及星坞各项系统所需的物品——例如计算机核心。

各个角色都能在任何违禁品储藏容器中检测到这些物品，因此你无需为使用他们的服务而先把物品取出来。

#en: Crew: 5% increased Ship-Based Missile Weapon Damage, 5% increased Ship-Based Missile Weapon Recharge speed.

zh: 船员：重力跃迁计算速度+20%，燃料消耗-20%。

zh: 船员：重力跃迁计算速度+10%，燃料消耗-10%。

zh: 船员：飞船货舱容量+10%。

#en: Crew: Shield System gains an extra unit of power.
zh: 船员：护盾系统获得1单位额外能量。

#en: Crew: Shield System capacity increased by 20%.
zh: 船员：护盾系统容量+20%。

#en: Crew: Shield System capacity increased by 10%.
zh: 船员：护盾系统容量+10%。

zh: 船员：飞船系统维修速度+20%。

zh: 船员：飞船系统维修速度+5%。

#en: Ship particle weapons do more damage.
zh: 飞船粒子武器伤害更高。

#en: Crew: 15% increased Ship-Based EM Weapon Damage, 15% increased Ship-Based EM Weapon Recharge speed.
zh: 船员：舰载电磁武器伤害+15%，舰载电磁武器充能速度+15%。

#en: Crew: 10% increased Ship-Based EM Weapon Damage, 10% increased Ship-Based EM Weapon Recharge speed.
zh: 船员：舰载电磁武器伤害+10%，舰载电磁武器充能速度+10%。

#en: Crew: 5% increased Ship-Based EM Weapon Damage, 5% increased Ship-Based EM Weapon Recharge speed.
zh: 船员：舰载电磁武器伤害+5%，舰载电磁武器充能速度+5%。

#en: Crew: 15% increased Ship-Based Energy Weapon Damage, 15% increased Ship-Based Energy Weapon Recharge speed.
zh: 船员：舰载能量武器伤害+15%，舰载能量武器充能速度+15%。

#en: Crew: 10% increased Ship-Based Energy Weapon Damage, 10% increased Ship-Based Energy Weapon Recharge speed.
zh: 船员：舰载能量武器伤害+10%，舰载能量武器充能速度+10%。

#en: Crew: 5% increased Ship-Based Energy Weapon Damage, 5% increased Ship-Based Energy Weapon Recharge speed.
zh: 船员：舰载能量武器伤害+5%，舰载能量武器充能速度+5%。

#en: Ship Reactors Produce a minor surplus of energy.
zh: 飞船反应堆产生少量额外能量。

#en: Watchtower has arrays all over the settled systems that can be used to track me. The more I destroy, the less likely they'll be to find me.
zh: 瞭望塔在定居星系群各处都设有阵列，可用来追踪我。我摧毁得越多，他们找到我的可能性就越小。

#en: We've succeeded in destroying Heimdall Station. Watchtower should no longer be a threat to me.
zh: 我们成功摧毁了海姆达尔站。瞭望塔应该不再是我的威胁。

#en: We've succeeded in destroying Heimdall Station and have escaped to the surface of Pyraas II. Gren should be able to return me to my ship.
zh: 我们成功摧毁了海姆达尔站，并逃到了派拉斯II的地表。格伦应该能把我送回飞船上。

#en: We've activated Heimdall Station's armillary and must now escape the station before it is destroyed.
zh: 我们已激活海姆达尔站的浑天仪，现在必须在空间站被摧毁前逃离。

#en: Torin and I have escaped from the strange realm the Watchtower Armillary brought us to. Now that Heimdall Station's armillary is charged, we should activate it and destroy the station.
zh: 我和托林已从瞭望塔浑天仪将我们带入的奇异领域逃脱。既然海姆达尔站的浑天仪已充能，我们应当激活它并摧毁该站。

#en: I've managed to locate Torin after we entered the Watchtower Armillary. There appears to be another armillary in this strange place. Activating it might be our key to escape.
zh: 进入瞭望塔浑天仪后，我设法找到了托林。这个奇异的地方似乎还有另一座浑天仪。激活它也许就是我们逃脱的关键。

#en: Torin has seemingly charged the Watchtower Armillary on Heimdall Station, but vanished in the process. I've gone into the armillary after him, and now find myself in an otherworldly realm. I should try to locate Torin.
zh: 托林似乎为海姆达尔站上的瞭望塔浑天仪充了能，却在此期间消失了。我跟着他进入了浑天仪，如今身处一个异界领域。我应该设法找到托林。

#en: Torin has seemingly charged the Watchtower Armillary on Heimdall Station, but has now vanished. I've activated the armillary without him, and must now escape the station on my own.
zh: 托林似乎为海姆达尔站上的瞭望塔浑天仪充了能，但如今已消失不见。我在没有他的情况下激活了浑天仪，现在必须独自逃离该站。

#en: Torin has seemingly charged the Watchtower Armillary on Heimdall Station, but has now vanished. I can either try to find him or activate the armillary without him.
zh: 托林似乎为海姆达尔站上的瞭望塔浑天仪充了能，但如今已消失不见。我可以选择去寻找他，或是不等他自己激活浑天仪。

#en: We've located Heimdall Station's mainframe. Torin plans to stay behind and activate the station's self-destruct. Now I must escape the station on my own.
zh: 我们找到了海姆达尔站的主机。托林打算留下并激活该站的自毁程序。现在我必须独自逃离该站。

#en: We've located Heimdall Station's mainframe. Torin has agreed to try using the armillary to destroy the station.
zh: 我们找到了海姆达尔站的主机。托林已同意尝试用浑天仪摧毁该站。

#en: We've located Heimdall Station's mainframe. Now to activate the station's self-destruct.
zh: 我们找到了海姆达尔站的主机。现在该激活该站的自毁程序了。

#en: We've attacked and boarded Heimdall Station, Watchtower's main base of operations. Now we must locate the station's mainframe and activate its self-destruct.
zh: 我们已进攻并登上海姆达尔站——瞭望塔的主要行动基地。现在我们须找到该站的主机并激活其自毁程序。

#en: Having fought off Heimdall Station's defenses, we can now board the station and locate its mainframe.
zh: 击退了海姆达尔站的防御后，我们现在可以登站并找到其主机。

#en: We've disabled the power source for Heimdall Station's cloak. The station is vulnerable now, and we must destroy its defenses.
zh: 我们已使海姆达尔站隐形装置的动力源失效。该站如今已暴露，我们必须摧毁其防御。

#en: After assaulting the power plant on Pyraas II, Watchtower attempted to use what appears to be an armillary of their own construction as a weapon against us. We must now disable the plant in order to locate and destroy Heimdall Station.
zh: 在袭击派拉斯II的发电厂后，瞭望塔试图用一座看似他们自行建造的浑天仪作为武器对付我们。我们现在必须关闭该发电厂，以便定位并摧毁海姆达尔站。

#en: We must disable the Watchtower Power Plant on Pyraas II  in order to locate and destroy Heimdall Station.
zh: 我们必须关闭派拉斯II上的瞭望塔发电厂，以便定位并摧毁海姆达尔站。

#en: Gren has found the source of Heimdall Station's cloak: a power station on the surface of Pyraas II. We must disable this power plant in order to locate Heimdall Station.
zh: 格伦找到了海姆达尔站隐形装置的来源：派拉斯II地表的一座发电站。我们必须关闭这座发电厂，才能定位海姆达尔站。

#en: Gren has found the source of Heimdall Station's cloak: a power station on the surface of Pyraas II.
zh: 格伦找到了海姆达尔站隐形装置的来源：派拉斯II地表的一座发电站。

#en: Torin's plan to destroy Watchtower has hit a roadblock. According to Gren, the station Torin assumes is Watchtower's main base is concealed by cloaking technology. Gren will need six computer cores to figure out what powers the cloak.
zh: 托林摧毁瞭望塔的计划遇到了阻碍。据格伦所说，托林认定是瞭望塔主基地的那座空间站被隐形技术遮蔽着。格伦需要六个计算机核心才能弄清隐形装置的动力来源。

#en: Torin has a plan to deal with Watchtower for good. He needs to speak to Gren about it first.
zh: 托林有一个彻底解决瞭望塔的计划。他需要先和格伦谈谈。

#en: Torin told me of our "past". We knew each other in the last universe, or at least his last universe. We were both captured by Watchtower and held prisoner on a space station. Over time, we came to depend on each other's company. In the end, we tried to escape and in the attempt I lost my life. But my sacrifice allowed Torin to get away and once he jumped through Unity, he sought me out to repay the favor. Now we have the Database and can find the location of our former prison in this universe and destroy it.
zh: 托林向我讲述了我们的"过去"。我们在上一个宇宙相识，至少是在他的上一个宇宙。我们都被瞭望塔抓获，关押在一座空间站里。日复一日，我们渐渐依赖彼此的陪伴。最后，我们试图逃跑，而在那次尝试中我失去了生命。但我的牺牲让托林得以逃脱，他穿过"归一"后便四处寻找我，以偿还这份恩情。现在我们有了数据库，可以在这个宇宙中定位我们曾被关押的地方，并将其摧毁。

#en: I sat to hear Torin finally reveal his full Starborn tale to me.
zh: 我坐下来，听托林终于向我完整讲述了他的星裔故事。

#en: Torin wants to talk again. He saved me a seat this time.
zh: 托林想再谈谈。这次他给我留了个座位。

#en: I made it back to Stardock. I should check with Torin.
zh: 我回到了星坞。我应该去和托林确认一下。

#en: Torin was right. The Database was here and holds a wealth of information. Watchtower knows about us, Gren, Harper, Stardock, everything. They are building a weapon in secret that even our fleet won't be able to withstand. We need to regroup at Stardock and see if Gren can pull even more data so we can find their base.
zh: 托林说得没错。数据库就在这里，其中信息极为丰富。瞭望塔知道我们、格伦、哈珀、星坞，知道一切。他们正在秘密建造一种连我们的舰队都无法抵挡的武器。我们需要在星坞重新集结，看看格伦能否提取更多数据，好让我们找到他们的基地。

#en: We have boarded the ship. Torin seems to know exactly what he's looking for...
zh: 我们已经登上了飞船。托林似乎很清楚自己在找什么……

#en: I have the codes to unlock the docker. The Database should be in the ship.
zh: 我拿到了解锁对接舱的密码。数据库应该就在那艘飞船里。

#en: I took out the Spacers in the Cargo Bay but the docker is still locked. The boss should have the codes on him.
zh: 我干掉了货舱里的太空劫匪，但对接舱仍然锁着。首领身上应该有密码。

#en: No time to waste with these Spacers. I need to take them out quickly.
zh: 没时间跟这些太空劫匪耗了。我得快点解决他们。

#en: It cost me a few credits but we have easy access to the Database now. we just need to board the ship.
zh: 花了我一些信用点，但现在我们能轻松接触数据库了。我们只需登船。

#en: I have persuaded the boss to let us into the ship and grab what we need.
zh: 我说服了首领放我们上船，取走我们需要的东西。

#en: This guy was easily persuaded by my skills. He unlocked the door to the ship that's docked. The Database should be up ahead.
zh: 这家伙轻易就被我的口才说服了。他打开了那艘已对接飞船的舱门。数据库应该就在前面。

#en: The boss of this gang has decided to talk to me. I should decide how to handle them. I could just fight my way through but they didn't attack me so, maybe there's a deal to be made here.
zh: 这伙人的首领决定跟我谈谈。我该决定如何应对他们。我本可以一路打过去，但他们并没有攻击我，所以也许可以做笔交易。

#en: The other docker is in the Cargo Bay. I see some Spacers standing guard but they don't seem to currently be alert to my presence -- or they don't care.
zh: 另一个对接舱在货舱里。我看到几个太空劫匪在站岗，但他们似乎并未警觉到我的存在——或者根本不在意。

#en: I found the keycard to the Cargo Bay. Now I can unlock the door and continue forward.
zh: 我找到了货舱的钥匙卡。现在我可以打开门继续前进了。

#en: I found another locked door leading to the Cargo Bay. Someone in here must have the keycard.
zh: 我又发现一扇通往货舱的锁着的门。这里一定有人持有钥匙卡。

#en: We made it halfway through the staryard and there are quite a few Spacers in here. They must have been using this as a base for a long time.
zh: 我们走过了造船厂的一半，这里面有不少太空劫匪。他们肯定把这里当据点用了很久。

#en: The Conference Room is open. Now I need to find where that ship is docked.
zh: 会议厅开了。现在我得找到那艘飞船对接在何处。

#en: I found the Security Pass to open the Conference Room door that's blocking our way forward.
zh: 我找到了安保通行证，可以打开挡住去路的会议厅门。

#en: I found a Security Terminal but I need to find a pass to unlock it.
zh: 我找到了一台安保终端，但需要找到通行证才能解锁。

#en: I found a locked door to a Conference Room and some blockage to my left. I need to find a way through.
zh: 我发现一扇通往会议厅的锁着的门，左侧也有障碍物。我需要找到通过的办法。

#en: I have made it onto the staryard. There are definitely Spacers roaming about. Torin thinks the Database is in a ship he spotted that's docked on the other end of the station. We'll have to fight our way through.
zh: 我进入了造船厂。这里确实有太空劫匪四处游荡。托林认为数据库就在他看到的、对接在空间站另一端的那艘飞船里。我们得一路打过去。

#en: Now that those ships are space dust, I need to board this staryard. Hopefully the Watchtower Database is still intact.
zh: 既然那些飞船已化为太空尘埃，我该登上这座造船厂了。但愿瞭望塔数据库还完好无损。

#en: I have found a staryard, along with a small fleet of Spacers. It seems they are currently in control. But first, I need to take out these ships.
zh: 我发现了一座造船厂，还有一小支太空劫匪舰队。看来目前是他们控制着这里。但首先，我得先解决这些飞船。

#en: Torin said that Watchtower has taken notice of our defiance. We need to take the fight to them while they are distracted. But first, he's going to follow me on a side-mission. He gave me coordinates to a station that holds some needed Watchtower intel.
zh: 托林说瞭望塔已经注意到我们的反抗。我们得趁他们分心时主动出击。但首先，他要跟我去做一个支线任务。他给了我一座空间站的坐标，那里存放着一些我们需要的瞭望塔情报。

#en: I have docked with Torin's ship. Now to find out what is on his mind.
zh: 我已与托林的飞船对接。现在去看看他心里在想什么。

#en: Torin needs to talk with me. I should see what is on his mind.
zh: 托林需要和我谈谈。我该去看看他心里在想什么。

#en: I received a data slate from Torin through a courier. He has something important to talk to me about. I should check and see what he wants.
zh: 我通过一名快递员收到了托林发来的数据板。他有重要的事要和我谈。我应该去看看他想说什么。

#en: Torin used a courier to send me a data slate. He has something he wants to talk to me about.
zh: 托林通过快递员给我送来一块数据板。他有话想和我谈。

#en: A courier caught up to me and gave me a data slate. I should read it to see who sent it.
zh: 一名快递员追上了我，给我一块数据板。我应该读一读，看看是谁寄来的。

#en: I recovered materials from the Watchtower Array in Altair. Harper was able to use them to locate more Watchtower Listening Posts, and Gren used them to upgrade my fleet.
zh: 我从牵牛星上的瞭望塔阵列中回收了材料。哈珀用它们定位出更多瞭望塔监听哨，格伦则用它们升级了我的舰队。

#en: I recovered materials from the Watchtower Array in Altair. I should return to Stardock and see what Harper and Gren have to say about it.
zh: 我从牵牛星上的瞭望塔阵列中回收了材料。我应该返回星坞，看看哈珀和格伦对此有何说法。

#en: The Listening Post did not have the data we needed, but did point us to an array that may.
zh: 监听哨里没有我们需要的数据，但为我们指明了一座可能有的阵列。

#en: I met Harper and Gren, and must now investigate a Watchtower Listening Post in the nearby system of Altair.
zh: 我见到了哈珀和格伦，现在须前往附近的牵牛星星系调查一处瞭望塔监听哨。

#en: Having returned to Stardock, I can now meet the other residents of the station.
zh: 回到星坞后，我现在可以去结识空间站里的其他居民。

#en: I retrieved the Control Node needed to assemble a fleet. I should return to Stardock with Torin to install it.
zh: 我取回了组装舰队所需的控制节点。我应该和托林一起返回星坞进行安装。

#en: With the mech disabled and the Control Node in hand, I need to return to Stardock with Torin.
zh: 机甲已失能，控制节点也已到手，我需要和托林一起返回星坞。

#en: I found a Terminal in the hangar foreman's office and used it to override the mech. Now, I need to talk to Torin.
zh: 我在机库工头办公室里找到一台终端，用它覆盖了机甲。现在我需要和托林谈谈。

#en: I found a Terminal in the hangar foreman's office and used the Engineer's Pass I printed earlier to override the mech. Now, I need to talk to Torin.
zh: 我在机库工头办公室里找到一台终端，用此前打印的工程师通行证覆盖了机甲。现在我需要和托林谈谈。

#en: Torin plans to use the Synapse Disruptor on the Corvette to disable the mech. But to do so, I need to flip four switches around the hangar to give him enough power.
zh: 托林打算用护卫舰上的突触干扰器使机甲失效。但为此，我需要扳动机库周围的四个开关，为他提供足够的电力。

#en: The "shutdown" mech was not inactive. Removing the Control Node seems to have triggered a lockdown and activated the mech. I need to avoid it at all costs while Torin checks on something in the Corvette.
zh: 那台"已关机"的机甲并非处于停机状态。取下控制节点似乎触发了封锁并激活了机甲。在托林检查护卫舰里的东西时，我必须不惜一切代价避开它。

#en: Somehow, Torin returned. But for now, I need to return to Stardock and install this Control Node.
zh: 不知怎么的，托林回来了。但现在，我需要返回星坞安装这个控制节点。

#en: I have the Control Node. I should return with it to Stardock.
zh: 我拿到了控制节点。我应该带着它返回星坞。

#en: The hangar is open. It is filled with large, heavy equipment and more mech parts, even one that is fully intact, though shutdown. There is also one of the Watchtower Corvettes on a platform in the center of the hangar. I will probably find the Control Node in there.
zh: 机库打开了。里面满是大型重型设备与更多机甲部件，甚至有一台完整无损、但已关机的机甲。机库中央的平台上还停着一艘瞭望塔护卫舰。我大概能在那里找到控制节点。

#en: I found a power distribution office with more locked doors, and a window that looks out to an expansive hangar. There is a bank of power switches that appear to activate and distribute the power to the hangar. I need to flip them in the proper order to unlock the doors.
zh: 我找到一间配电办公室，里面还有更多锁着的门，一扇窗户正对着一座宽阔的机库。那里有一组电力开关，似乎用于激活并分配机库的电力。我需要按正确顺序扳动它们才能解锁舱门。

#en: I made it past the worker's area. There's a large ramp leading up. I still need to find the Control Node.
zh: 我穿过了工人区。有一条宽阔的坡道向上延伸。我仍需找到控制节点。

#en: I flipped the correct switch to reset the power to the door.
zh: 我扳动了正确的开关，重置了舱门的电力。

#en: I hacked the Engineer's Terminal and triggered the override for the door's power reset.
zh: 我黑入了工程师终端，触发了舱门电力重置的覆盖程序。

#en: There are three unlabeled switches and one of them will reset the power to the blocked door. One controls an elevator, but is shorting, and the other will trigger a security lockdown in the worker area. I need to flip the correct switch.
zh: 有三个没有标签的开关，其中一个能重置被堵住舱门的电力。一个控制电梯，但正在短路；另一个会触发工人区的安保封锁。我需要扳动正确的开关。

#en: I passed through a worker's area with a number of terminals, servers, a large tower, and other heavy equipment. Watchtower was definitely researching advanced tech here. I also ran into another locked door. I need to find a way through.
zh: 我穿过了一片工人区，那里有许多终端、服务器、一座高塔和其他重型设备。瞭望塔肯定在这里研究先进科技。我还遇到另一扇锁着的门。我需要找到通过的办法。

#en: I have made it through the facility's security checkpoint. Watchtower are serious about keeping this place locked up.
zh: 我通过了设施的安保检查点。瞭望塔想把这地方封住，可是动了真格。

#en: I've entered the Watchtower Listening Post. It is abandoned, but there are mech parts all around, and security is still active. I need to explore and find this Control Node, and maybe some more information about Watchtower as well.
zh: 我进入了瞭望塔监听哨。这里已被废弃，但到处是机甲部件，安保系统仍在运作。我需要探索并找到这个控制节点，也许还能找到更多关于瞭望塔的情报。

#en: Torin crashed his ship right into the mech. It was destroyed, but so was Torin's ship. He told me to continue on to the Control Node and then return to Stardock where his friends will be waiting.
zh: 托林驾船直接撞向了机甲。机甲被摧毁了，但托林的飞船也毁了。他让我继续前往控制节点，然后返回星坞，他的朋友们会在那里等我。

#en: Torin has a plan for dealing with the mech. I need to keep my distance.
zh: 托林有对付机甲的计划。我需要保持距离。

#en: The Skydrop destroyed the door and cleared the way, but now there is an automated mech in the way. Its shields seem to be impervious to my weapons.
zh: 空投摧毁了舱门、清出了通道，但现在前方又出现了一台自动机甲。它的护盾似乎对我的武器免疫。

#en: The flare is on target. Torin will send a Surface Missile from space.
zh: 曳光弹已命中目标。托林将从太空发射地表导弹。

#en: Torin called me from orbit and told me to select a Surface Missile for the Skydrop Flare he gave me. Then, I need to throw the flare close enough to the ice-covered doors for him to get a proper reading.
zh: 托林从轨道呼叫我，让我为他给我的空投曳光弹选择地表导弹。然后，我需要把曳光弹扔到离结冰舱门足够近的地方，好让他能取得准确的读数。

#en: I have landed near the facility. It isn't too far away but it is quite cold.
zh: 我已在设施附近着陆。距离不算太远，但相当寒冷。

#en: I defeated the Watchtower Drones. Now, I need to land and find the facility itself.
zh: 我击败了瞭望塔无人机。现在我需要着陆并找到设施本身。

#en: We've found the facility but some Drones have detected us and jumped in. I need to defeat them before heading to the surface.
zh: 我们找到了设施，但一些无人机发现我们并跃迁了过来。我需要先击败它们，再前往地表。

#en: Torin has a plan to deal with Watchtower - building a fleet. First, I have to retrieve a Control Node.
zh: 托林有对付瞭望塔的计划——组建一支舰队。首先，我得取回一个控制节点。

#en: The stranger, Torin, told me the group is called Watchtower. They use advanced technology and weapons to track down "special" individuals. Their Synapse Disruptor disabled both me and my ship. Torin has a plan to deal with them however - building a fleet. First, I have to retrieve something called a Control Node.
zh: 那个陌生人托林告诉我，这个组织叫瞭望塔。他们用先进的技术和武器追捕"特殊"个体。他们的突触干扰器让我和我的飞船都失去了行动能力。不过托林有对付他们的计划——组建一支舰队。首先，我得取回一件叫作控制节点的东西。

#en: I was ambushed and captured by a group of Watchtower ships. Torin jumped in and rescued me. He gave me coordinates to meet him at Stardock.
zh: 我遭到一队瞭望塔飞船的伏击并被俘。托林跃迁赶来救了我。他给了我坐标，让我在星坞与他会合。

#en: I was ambushed and captured by a mysterious group of ships. A stranger jumped in and rescued me. He gave me coordinates to meet him at his starstation and he'll explain who they are.
zh: 我遭到一队神秘飞船的伏击并被俘。一个陌生人跃迁赶来救了我。他给了我坐标，让我去他的星际站与他会面，届时他会解释他们是谁。

#en:
Log Entry - Safehouse Viability Declining

This facility was meant to be a rest stop. Resupply, recover, move on. That was before the cold set in.

Now, systems are failing faster than we can patch them. Power grids strain to keep up, heat distribution is unreliable, and ice buildup is locking down access points.

Agent Davis doesn't seem to care. Spends his breaks by that dead forklift, eating like we're not one system failure away from losing this place entirely. Meanwhile, I'm patching infrastructure for equipment I don't even recognize.

Ran a diagnostic sweep on the failing terminals. Something's piggybacking on the network. Could be tied to the classified projects moving through here, or it could be something worse. Either way, it's locked up tight.

If nothing changes soon, this safehouse won't be safe much longer.
zh:
日志条目——安全屋存续能力持续下降

这处设施本是个休息站。补给、休整、继续上路。那还是严寒降临之前的事。

如今，系统崩溃的速度已快过我们修补的速度。电网勉力支撑，供热分配不可靠，结冰正封锁一个个通道。

戴维斯特工似乎毫不在意。休息时间就待在那台报废叉车旁，照吃照喝，好像我们离彻底失去这地方只差一次系统故障这种事跟他无关。而我却在为一些我根本认不出的设备修补基础设施。

对故障终端做了一次诊断扫描。有东西在搭网络的便车。可能与此处流转的机密项目有关，也可能更糟。无论如何，它被锁得死死的。

若不久后仍无改变，这座安全屋就安全不了多久了。

#en:
Once imprinted, the Astralgate will serve as a stable point of convergence, ensuring complete segregation of secured Deviant. The field remains active so long as the core maintains integrity. 

If stability fluctuates, do not attempt manual overrides. Shutdown is not an option once containment has begun. The system is functioning as intended.

Once successfully imprinted with a Deviant's signature, an Astralgate can discharge the infused power a single time before it enters a reabsorption cycle, triggering a gravity wave to pull in any nearby Deviants for reimprinting.

This function remains unstable and is not yet approved for field deployment.
zh:
一旦完成印记，星界之门将作为稳定的汇聚点，确保被收容的异常体被彻底隔离。只要核心保持完好，力场就会一直处于激活状态。

若稳定性出现波动，切勿尝试手动覆盖。收容一旦开始，关闭便不再是可选项。系统正按预期运行。

一旦成功印上某异常体的特征印记，星界之门便可单次释放所灌注的能量，随后进入再吸收循环，触发一道重力波，将附近的异常体吸入以便重新印记。

此功能仍不稳定，尚未获准投入实地使用。

#en:
1. Frame Assembly
- Construct primary ring using reinforced gravitic-alloy plating. The frame must be able to withstand extreme spatial distortions.
- Integrate stabilization pylons at equidistant points along the outer circumference. These regulate spatial cohesion and prevent collapse under energy load.
- Route power conduits through an internal lattice of phase-shifted superconductors to ensure proper energy cycling.

2. Core Installation
- Mount a Quantum Convergence Core at the Astralgate's central plexus. This acts as the focal point for energy manipulation and imprint stabilization.
- Install a Sub-Harmonic Containment Field to prevent premature energy discharge.
- Ensure all energy conduits are properly shielded to prevent cascading feedback loops.

3. Power Calibration
- Link Astralgate to external power source with at least a 5.3 terawatt sustained output.
- Engage phased cycling protocols to align energy flow with the Core's resonance threshold.
- Run diagnostic scans to confirm stability before initiating imprinting protocols.

4. Imprinting Process
- Activate the Neural Wave Harmonizer to detect and attune the gate to a deviant's energy signature.
- Expose the Astralgate's Core to an active Deviant ability. Sustained contact for no less than 4.5 seconds is required for imprint registration.
- Monitor imprint synchronization levels - optimal imprint is reached at 97% resonance match.
- Once infused, the Core will enter a primed state, ready for single-use discharge.

5. Post-Imprint Protocols
- After discharge, the Astralgate will enter reabsorption cycle, attempting to draw in new Deviant energy via a localized gravity well.
- Due to instability in this feature, personnel are advised to maintain a minimum safe distance until further refinements are implemented.
- Do not attempt manual reimprinting until the Core has fully reset to baseline levels. Premature interference may result in catastrophic feedback.

WARNING: Any deviation from standard procedure may result in uncontrolled energy surges, Core destabilization, or spatial anomalies. Only authorized personnel with Level-4 clearance or higher are permitted to oversee construction and imprinting.
zh:
1. 框架组装
- 使用强化重力合金装甲板构建主环。框架必须能够承受极端的空间扭曲。
- 在外周等距位置安装稳定支柱。它们用于调节空间凝聚力，防止在能量负载下发生坍塌。
- 将电力导管穿过由相位偏移超导体构成的内部网格，以确保能量循环正常。

2. 核心安装
- 在星界之门的中央丛位安装量子汇聚核心。它充当能量操纵与印记稳定的焦点。
- 安装亚谐波收容力场，防止能量过早释放。
- 确保所有能量导管都得到适当屏蔽，以防出现级联反馈循环。

3. 电力校准
- 将星界之门连接至外部电源，持续输出至少须达5.3太瓦。
- 启用相位循环协议，使能量流与核心的共振阈值对齐。
- 运行诊断扫描以确认稳定，然后再启动印记协议。

4. 印记流程
- 激活神经波协调器，探测并让闸门与异常体的能量特征协调一致。
- 让星界之门的核心暴露于活跃的异常体能力之下。需要持续接触不少于4.5秒才能登记印记。
- 监测印记同步水平——共振匹配达到97%时即达到最佳印记。
- 灌注完成后，核心将进入待发状态，可进行单次释放。

5. 印记后协议
- 释放之后，星界之门将进入再吸收循环，试图通过局部重力井吸入新的异常体能量。
- 由于此功能尚不稳定，建议人员在进一步完善前保持最小安全距离。
- 在核心完全恢复至基线水平之前，切勿尝试手动重新印记。过早干涉可能导致灾难性反馈。

警告：任何偏离标准流程的行为都可能导致能量失控喷涌、核心失稳或空间异常。只有持有4级或更高权限的授权人员方可监督建造与印记作业。

#en:
The coordinates for the Spacer station should've auto updated your nav computer. You're good to go.

But, hey! Good on you for double checking the Slate, just in case!

- Torin
zh:
太空劫匪空间站的坐标应该已自动更新到你的导航电脑了。你可以出发了。

不过，嘿！你还会再去核对一遍数据板，以防万一，这挺好！

- 托林

#en:
Make your way to the Piazzi system, there's a station there you can dock with. I've made sure you have docking permission.

I'll be waiting for you there.

- A friend
zh:
前往皮亚兹星系，那里有一座可以对接的空间站。我已确保你拥有对接许可。

我会在那里等你。

- 一位朋友

#en:
Had to strip out the reactor, pull the Skydrop module. This corvette's no better than a deadweight now.

I've patched what I can, but without new parts there's not much more I can do.

We haven't been given the order yet, but we all feel it coming. The facility's failing.

I need more time. Won't get it.

- Field Agent Engineer Gren
zh:
不得不拆掉反应堆，卸下空投模块。这艘护卫舰现在跟一堆废铁没什么两样。

能补的我尽量补了，但没有新零件，我也做不了更多。

我们还没接到命令，但大家都感觉到它要来了。设施正在崩坏。

我需要更多时间。但不会有了。

- 外勤特工工程师格伦

#en:
Hey, got something I wanna talk about, but figured it's probably best we discuss it in person.

It's about... you know, our overbearing "friends".

Meet me at Stardock as soon as you can. Don't keep me waiting!

- Your bestest pal, Torin
zh:
嘿，我有些事想谈，但想来还是当面说比较好。

是关于……你知道的，我们那些专横的"朋友"。

尽快来星坞找我。别让我等太久！

- 你最好的哥们，托林

#en:
Reason for Loss:
Unknown. Must have fallen off at some point. Retraced my steps twice, nothing. Only noticed when I couldn't access my workstation this morning.

Statement of Responsibility:
I accept full responsibility. I understand ID security protocols and will ensure this does not happen again.

Additional Notes:
I understand this is my second report. But I've been careful, really careful. This was just an accident. Please do not escalate this to Security. I'll take extra precautions, double-check everything.


Requesting replacement processing ASAP. Will comply with any remedial action necessary, just don't make me go through Security conditioning again.
zh:
遗失原因：
不明。一定是在途中某处掉了。我沿着原路找了两遍，一无所获。直到今早无法登录工作站时才发觉。

责任声明：
我承担全部责任。我明白身份卡安保规程，并会确保不再发生此事。

补充说明：
我知道这已是我第二次上报。但我一直很小心，真的非常小心。这只是一次意外。请不要上报安保部门。我会采取额外防范，逐一复核。


请求尽快办理补发。任何必要的补救措施我都愿意配合，只是别再让我接受安保部门的再教育了。

#en:
Progress Log -- AI Hibernation Compliance

Ongoing issues with long-term storage protocols. The Mechs refuse to accept shutdown commands. Even after full system overrides, neural matrices resist power-down, treating hibernation as a hostile action.

Some attempt reactivation within minutes. Others go dark but spike back online at random intervals, sometimes days later.


Current status:
Combat Robot Units: No significant issues. VI routines recognize dormancy protocols and remain offline as expected.

Mech Systems: Persistent noncompliance. Some units lock into diagnostic loops. Others attempt unauthorized boot sequences. A few have even overridden safety protocols to maintain minimal power draw.

Network Stability: Unclear if this is emergent behavior or residual command bleed from past operations. Latency checks show nothing abnormal, but something in the system doesn't want to be put to sleep.


Containment measures are in place, but this needs a permanent fix. If a facility evacuation is ordered, we'll be leaving an unpredictable system in storage.
zh:
进展日志——AI休眠合规情况

长期储存协议持续存在问题。机甲拒绝接受关机指令。即便在完整系统覆盖之后，神经矩阵仍抗拒断电，将休眠视为敌对行为。

有些在几分钟内就尝试重启。另一些会沉寂下来，却在随机的时间间隔后重新上线，有时是几天之后。


当前状态：
战斗机器人单元：无重大问题。虚拟智能例程能识别休眠协议，并按预期保持离线。

机甲系统：持续不服从。部分单元陷入诊断循环。另一些尝试未经授权的启动序列。还有少数甚至覆盖了安全协议，以维持最低限度的耗电。

网络稳定性：尚不清楚这是涌现行为，还是过往行动残留的指令渗漏。延迟检测未显示任何异常，但系统里有什么东西不想被送去休眠。


收容措施已到位，但这需要永久性的修复。若下令撤离设施，我们将把一套不可预测的系统留在储存状态中。

#en:
Requesting immediate reassignment from this facility.

Current post does not align with my expertise or operational priorities. Tasking is repetitive. Power regulation, switch monitoring, system maintenance with minimal strategic significance. My skills are being wasted on low-priority functions.

The main hangar remains the facility's primary focus, yet my role in its upkeep is redundant. If there is a broader objective here, it is above my clearance level and irrelevant to my duties.

Security protocols continue to escalate. Lockdown drills are increasing, access restrictions tightening. There is a shift in posture that suggests an unspoken threat. If risks have changed, personnel should be informed. Instead, we are expected to work without context.
Remaining here serves no purpose. Requesting reassignment to a post where my skills can be of actual use. Awaiting confirmation of transfer orders.

-- T. Bellamy
*Draft saved but not submitted.*
zh:
申请立即从本设施调离。

目前岗位与我的专业及行动优先级不符。任务重复单调。电力调节、开关监控、系统维护，战略价值微乎其微。我的才能正被浪费在低优先级职能上。

主机库仍是设施的重中之重，可我在其维护中的角色却是多余的。如果这里有什么更大的目标，那也在我的权限层级之上，与我的职责无关。

安保规程不断升级。封锁演练愈发频繁，出入限制愈发收紧。这种态势转变暗示着某种不便明言的威胁。如果风险有变，就应当告知人员。可我们却被要求在毫不知情的情况下干活。
留在这里毫无意义。请求调往一个我的才能真正能派上用场的岗位。等待调职命令的确认。

—— T. 贝拉米
*草稿已保存但未提交。*

#en:
Mechs are coming in faster than we can process. Regular shipments are backing up.

Manifests don't match, and no one's giving answers. R&D walks in, takes what they want and leaves the rest, no documentation, no explanations.

Forklifts have been restricted for "sensitive material," leaving my crew scrambling over crates. Efficiency is tanking.

If our Officers expect results, they need to stop overriding standard operations.

Clarification is requested.
zh:
机甲送来的速度已经快过我们处理的速度。常规货运正在积压。

清单对不上，也没人给个说法。研发部的人走进来，拿走想要的，丢下其余的，不留记录，不作解释。

叉车被以"敏感材料"为由限制使用，害得我的手下只能搬着货箱来回忙活。效率一落千丈。

如果长官们想要成果，就别再随意压过标准作业流程。

请求予以说明。

#en:
Draft Message:

Nate,

I'm not meant to send outside messages, but I'm fairly sure I can slip this one out without anyone noticing.

I'm still working for that organization, the one I can't talk about. Didn't expect to stay this long, but they pay well and on time. Hard to walk away from that.

When 1-Of-A-Kind Salvage cut me loose, (foreman didn't like my tabs showing up on the books), I was dead in the water. But these guys pulled me out. Debt wiped clean, no lecture, just expectations and quotas. I just have to keep quiet and do my job. Simple.

The work's fairly compartmentalized. I get coordinates, then haul in containers. I don't ask what's in them, don't really see the need anymore. I just do the job, get paid.

A few more months and I'll decide if I'm staying on with these guys. I'll need to have another medical treatment, but the last wasn't so bad.

Anyway, enough about me. How have you been? How's your sister?


-J

[AUTOMATED SECURITY NOTICE]
Attempt to transmit external mail has been blocked. Unauthorized outbound communication is not permitted.
If you believe this is an error, contact your system administrator. Unauthorized attempts will be logged and reviewed.
zh:
草拟讯息：

内特，

我本不该向外发送讯息，但我相当确定能把这条悄悄发出去而不被人察觉。

我还在为那个组织干活，就是我不能提的那个。没料到会待这么久，但他们付钱大方、从不拖欠。很难说走就走。

当初"独一份打捞公司"把我踢出去时（工头不喜欢我的欠账单出现在账本上），我算是彻底完了。但这些人把我捞了出来。债务一笔勾销，没有说教，只有指标和配额。我只要闭嘴干活就行。简单。

这里的工作分得很细。我拿到坐标，然后把集装箱运回来。我不问里面是什么，如今也觉得没必要问。我就干活、领钱。

再过几个月，我再决定要不要跟着这帮人干下去。我还得再做一次医疗处理，不过上次也没那么糟。

好了，不说我了。你最近怎么样？你妹妹还好吗？


-J

[自动安保通知]
向外发送邮件的尝试已被阻止。不允许未经授权的对外通信。
若你认为这是误判，请联系系统管理员。未经授权的尝试将被记录并审查。

#en:
The following parts are needed for Watchtower component fabrication:

1x Semimetal Wafer
4x Caelumite
2x Antimony
1x Tasine Superconductor
zh:
制造瞭望塔组件需要以下部件：

1x 半金属晶圆
4x 卡鲁镅
2x 锑
1x 塔锌超导体

#en:
Log Entry:

Security continues to flag munitions shortages. Stock levels are within expected parameters given current supply delays. If they require expedited restock, they'll need to submit formal requisition requests through the proper channels. Complaints are irrelevant without action.

Local wildlife remains a variable. One breached the outer loading bay last week, damaging a maintenance unit before perimeter turrets neutralized it. Recommend additional defenses. Command maintains current systems are ""sufficient."" Noted.

Facility infrastructure remains inefficient. Power-routing switches remain unlabeled despite repeated requests. Engineering insists memorization is adequate. It is not. Potential for operational failure remains high.

Armory operations remain functional. Shooting range is operational. No further issues to report at this time.
zh:
日志条目：

安保部门持续反映弹药短缺。考虑到当前的供应延误，库存水平仍在预期参数之内。若他们需要加急补货，就须通过正当渠道提交正式领用申请。光抱怨而不采取行动毫无意义。

当地野生动物仍是变数。上周有一头闯入了外部装卸舱，损坏了一台维护单元，随后被周边炮塔消灭。建议增加防御。指挥部坚持现有系统已经""足够""。已记录在案。

设施基础设施依然低效。配电开关在多次请求后仍未贴标签。工程部坚称凭记忆就够用。并不够。作业故障的可能性依然很高。

军械库运作正常。靶场可正常使用。目前无其他问题需要上报。

#en: Phase through the normal flow of time and slow down the universe for a duration.
zh: 穿越时间的正常流动，使宇宙在一段时间内减速。

#en: Launches a gravity wave in a cone ahead of you that staggers and knocks down enemies.
zh: 向你前方锥形区域释放一道重力波，使敌人踉跄并被击倒。

#en: Create an area of dense gravity that pulls in and crushes everything and everyone in around it.
zh: 创造一个高密度重力区域，将周围的一切和所有人吸入并碾碎。

#en: Sends out a wave of gravity blasting everyone in the area far away.
zh: 释放一道重力波，将区域内所有人远远震飞。
